The confirmation can turn ten retained E0 inputs into bounded reproducible E1 evidence. The companion can separately explain unresolved historical assurance cases without changing them.
The local checker-profile consumer gives confirmation immediate maintenance value. No upstream write follows; the companion remains useful for public interpretation.
Reuse the exact retained inputs, importer, analyzers and supervisor under fresh E1 gates. The companion reuses the bound assurance snapshot and dated evidence ledger.
Confirmation preparation can replace the old container dependency with a portable recipe. The companion is already locally executable if confirmation reaches a genuine capability boundary.

Retain READY as the next independent output; it can improve interpretation without checker execution or missing cloud evidence.
